v1_effect_before_LayerNorm.note: Centering isolates the effect entering candidate LayerNorm, not the final output difference

null_head.activation: abstain for an entire query when sigmoid(w^T h + b) > 0.5
null_head.bias_lowering_effect: for identical query states, removes some abstentions; may add false positives

v1_assessment: bounded spectral experiment; not ontology-conditioned adaptation

semantic_identifiability.type_representation: contextual entity schema marker states in the shared encoder
semantic_identifiability.class_scores: shared boundary + inside + span/query dot product + FiLM scores

intervention_rules: Never infer harmful noise from a large singular value alone
Analyze H W with H=I-11^T/d for maps contributing directly before LayerNorm
Analyze paired affine kernels for dot-product projections before modifying either factor
A shared scoring change affects every schema query, not a named ontology class
Leave encoder Q/K, embeddings, LayerNorm scales, biases and auxiliary/task heads intact unless there is a specific supported hypothesis
decision: No evidence of a defective or semantically misdirected weight; no arbitrary second edit
